_readme: PS Linker Store catalog. All entries MUST point at content that is legally distributable (homebrew, freeware, demos, or your own legally-obtained files). This catalog is served over the PS Linker HTTP share; the PSP/PS3 apps fetch it at /catalog.json. Copy this file into your games/content directory (or the HTTP share root). 'icon' is optional and may be an empty string.

items.title: Doom PSP (Homebrew Port)
items.description: Open-source Doom port for PSP. Requires a WAD file you legally own, placed next to the EBOOT.

items.title: Cave Story PSP (Freeware Port)
items.description: Port of the freeware classic Cave Story (Pixel's original freeware release).

items.title: PSP Clock (Homebrew Utility)
items.description: Simple fullscreen clock homebrew. Replace with any homebrew utility you download from its official site.
